scope: Actual installed terranx.exe running in Boxedwine/Wine WebAssembly. No public edits, game binary patches, or simulation-state reads/writes. Browser inputs only.

sections.heading: Mouse movement; Examining the map
findings: Left-drag a unit to set a destination; release issues the order.
The path can be displayed before movement, with up to three waypoints including destination.
Plain left-click recenters; units activate and bases open their control screen.

sections.heading: Right-click menu
findings: Move Unit to Here issues movement for the active unit.
Options depend on clicked square, including unit Action or Terraform and base controls.

limits: No all-reachable-tiles overlay was observed; this is a native selected-route preview.
Native Dist values include fractions and Dist1 at the origin; their exact formula was not recovered by this runtime probe.
No attack, transport, naval, air, multi-unit, faction, or full map pathfinding parity is claimed.
Return-to-origin cancellation was tested with unchanged camera; map scrolling can invalidate stored screen coordinates.
Shift/drag flag alone does not establish that the clicked square contained the selected unit.
Escape and Backslash were unsuitable cancellation methods in the observed restored-world mode.
This probe does not validate any new bridge, pointer adapter, or future public implementation.
